description.value:
Attack bonus +1. After an attack, gain +1 attack bonus per distinct target hit, capped at +3, for your next attack. Hitting at least 3 enemies also grants speed +10 feet for 1 turn.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching erudition Path required.
